name: MoonMod Pack
author: Jeffiest and the MoonMod contributors
description: The MoonMod mods in one: Autosave, Controls, Expanded Town Camera, Modern Cloud, SirFancyBacon Mod Pack, Living Towns, Dungeon+, RPG: Character Paths, Dark Genie's Gauntlet (Roguelike), Opar in the Story, Vigil, MoonMod Hub. One switch turns them all on or off; each part has its own switch and settings under the pack in the Mod Manager, and keeps its own saved progress.

parts.name: SirFancyBacon Mod Pack
parts.description: Quality-of-life ideas from SirFancyBacon's Chronicle branches (qol-pack, floor-select), as a MoonMod mod. An Auto Repair Powder in your bag saves a weapon about to break, as one in a quick slot does. T mends the active weapon with a Repair Powder from the bag. The dungeon's floor list warns, before you go in, of a floor that lets only one character in, locks your weapon, or dries you out faster. Each part has its own setting.

parts.name: Living Towns
parts.description: The towns ask things of you after their houses are rebuilt. Each day the villagers post three bounties on the board (hunt in a dungeon, open its chests, go deeper, or bring them something), sized to how far your story has gone. A villager waits by the exit gate on a bounty's floors and pays you there. And the general stores stock better goods as each new dungeon is reached.

parts.name: RPG: Character Paths
parts.description: A real character build for every hero. Kills give XP, levels give HP, damage, toughness and skill points. Each of the six heroes spends them on three paths of their own in the Journal's Character page, each path ending in a power: Toan's Swordsman, Survivor and Explorer, Xiao's Hunter, Nimble and Forager, Goro's Might, Stone and Appetite, Ruby's Arcana, Grace and Fortune, Ungaga's Spearman, Shaman and Champion, Osmond's Gunner, Armor and Surveyor. Weapon mastery, loot rolls and the DarkCloud-Expanded weapon abilities stay.

parts.name: Dark Genie's Gauntlet (Roguelike)
parts.description: A roguelike game mode on the title menu. Dark Genie's Gauntlet has its own title screen and its own progress: Start Run begins a fresh game that belongs to no save file and drops you onto the first floor of a forward-only run through five biomes, three floors and a Warden each. Cursed Gates, fast ABS, one weapon each (a broken one ends the run), an in-run Diorama, drafted allies and Moon Shards for the Norune Eternal unlocks. Needs the MoonFactory engine with title modes.

settings.description: Divine Beast Cave, Wise Owl Forest, Shipwreck, Sun and Moon Temple and Moon Sea, in that order.

settings.name: Shuffle biome order

New moves
settings.description: New animated attacks, an L2 evade and combos. Toan: Dash Slash, Spinning Sweep, Counter Slash, roll and backstep. Xiao: Triple Shot, tumble and hop shot. Goro and Ungaga get a melee set, Ruby and Osmond a set of shots. R2 is a heavy attack; A,A,R2 and A,A,A,R2 are finishers; locked on, toward or away + A lunge in or strike backing off; A out of an evade follows it up. The evades also cut an attack short once its blow lands.

settings.name: Weapon rarity, touches and legendaries

settings.description: Dran, Master Utan, the Ice Queen, King's Curse or Minotaur Joe, each with its own cast; otherwise the floor's toughest monster grows into the Warden.

settings.name: The Confluence: each floor runs through several dungeons, a new one past each gate
settings.description: A floor before a Warden starts in its own dungeon; past each locked gate the next dungeon takes over, with its own rooms, spring and monsters, a step lower. The Rest floor, the Wardens and the Lair stay one dungeon.

settings.name: One map per biome: its floors are zones of one map
settings.description: With the Confluence on, a biome's floors before its Warden are one map: each floor is a zone in a dungeon of its own, past a locked gate, and walking through a gate is the next floor. The last zone's exit gate leads to the Warden. Takes the place of shuffled floors.

settings.name: One map for the whole run
settings.description: With One map per biome on, the whole run is one map: every biome's floors, then its Warden's hall (the way on stays shut until the Warden falls), a Rest stop with a healing spring and Gaffer, on to the next biome, and the Genie's Lair at the very end. No Vaults or Cursed Path on it.

settings.name: The Confluence: dungeons a floor runs through
Finale: the Genie's Lair after the last Warden
settings.description: One more floor after the last biome's Warden. The Dark Genie fights there in his pink form and his dark elemental form: one after the other in either order, or both at once, each with a random share of its spells. Beating him wins the run.

settings.name: Rest floor between biomes
settings.description: After each Warden but the last: a hall with a healing spring and Gaffer's shop, then two ways on. The exit gate leads to the next biome as usual; the stairs in the side room take the Cursed Path, where every floor of that biome before its Warden is cursed (richer chests, a Miracle cache each, and a Warden that pays out twice).

parts.name: Opar in the Story
parts.description: Opar, the frog mage, joins the story with Xiao. Baby Opar's Atla lies on the Divine Beast Cave's 8th floor, beside the cat's. Found, he waits in Toan's house beside the cat; in her scene he turns into Opar, and both join. Needs the MoonFactory engine with registered playable characters and mod Atla.

parts.name: Vigil
parts.description: Souls-lite combat for the story game, first prototype (S1). L2 evades (a roll, or a backstep at rest) spend the weapon gauge, so stamina gates them. Enemies hit harder, and a hit stuns you for less time and so protects you for less. Toan gains a heavy attack, combo finishers and lunges. Enemies with a brain circle you, track you through a wind-up, feint, punish a whiffed swing and take turns attacking. Holding the guard slows the gauge's recovery. See VIGIL_PLAN.md.
